triage.headline: This sounds like it could be a medical emergency.
triage.explanation: Jo symptoms tumne describe kiye hain unmein kuch red-flag words hain jo turant medical attention maangte hain. Isse AI se analyse karwane ke bajaye abhi real help lena zyada zaroori hai.

flags.reason: Matched a red-flag phrase in our safety check.

warning_signs: Any worsening of the above — do not wait, go now.
triage.disclaimer: Ye ek automated keyword-based safety check hai, poori medical assessment nahi. Turant nearest hospital jao ya emergency services (112) ko call karo.
